subject: Security notification: Payment processing anomaly — IR playbook & postmortem
messages:
From: Dana Sullivan <dana.sullivan@prosperitypay.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mchen@prosperitypay.com>, legal@prosperitypay.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unusual clearing errors — request for IR playbook and next steps

Hi Marissa,

We saw a cluster of clearing failures across a subset of transactions last night between 23:02–23:14 PST (approx 0.6% of volume). Our ops team isolated the traffic pattern and pulled related logs — we redacted PII and attached a tarball with the event traces.

The board has asked for two things ASAP: a short summary of Redwood's incident response steps and a copy of your current IR playbook (SOC 2 / SIG artifacts) that Prosperity Pay can use for our post-incident review. Can you also confirm whether Redwood will share a postmortem once internal analysis completes?

Attachments: prosperity_pay_event_logs_redacted.tar.gz (logs, redacted)

Thanks,
Dana Sullivan
Director, Risk & Compliance
Prosperity Pay

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Sullivan <dana.sullivan@prosperitypay.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 10:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unusual clearing errors — request for IR playbook and next steps

Hi Dana — thanks for the heads-up and for the redacted logs. I'm escalating this to our on-call security and infra leads. Short answers up front: yes, we will share our IR playbook and a postmortem; we can also coordinate a joint blameless review.

What I'm sharing now: 
- Redwood IR playbook (summary): attached (redwood_ir_playbook_v1.4.pdf). The playbook contains our escalation matrix, containment steps, evidence handling guidance, and cross-team RACI.
- Immediate next step: we propose a 30-minute sync today or tomorrow to align timelines — I can host a screen-share to walk through the logs.

Could you confirm whether Prosperity Pay needs the playbook under an NDA or a signed DPA scope change before we share the full postmortem (we typically redact customer-identifying telemetry where required)? If you need a formal evidence-handoff, we can provide checksums and an encrypted transfer method.

Public note: we are treating this as a P2 and have invoked our incident DOM (duty ops meeting). Karthik and Neha are on triage.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_ir_playbook_v1.4.pdf

From: Mike Chen <mchen@prosperitypay.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Sullivan <dana.sullivan@prosperitypay.com>, legal@prosperitypay.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jan 2028 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unusual clearing errors — request for IR playbook and next steps

Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the quick reply. We reviewed the playbook PDF and appreciate the containment checklist. Two asks from Prosperity Pay's side: 

1) Can Redwood produce a redacted timeline of actions (who did what, timestamps) for the window 23:00–23:30 PST? That will help us correlate with our logs.
2) For any artifacts you plan to share (postmortem + telemetry), Prosperity Pay requires either an executed MSA addendum or a standard evidence transfer agreement for regulated data. Legal is looped in on this thread.

We started a JIRA ticket internally for tracking: https://prosperitypay.atlassian.net/browse/PP-4562. We also included a DocuSign link if Redwood prefers the evidence agreement route.

Attachments: none

On Tue, Jan 15, 2028 at 10:06 AM marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> (quoted above)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Sullivan <dana.sullivan@prosperitypay.com>, Mike Chen <mchen@prosperitypay.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unusual clearing errors — IR timeline, evidence transfer, and postmortem link

Dana / Mike — following up with the artifacts you requested.

What we delivered:
- A redacted action timeline (23:00–23:30 PST) is embedded in the postmortem PDF (prosperity_pay_postmortem_v1.0.pdf). The timeline indicates our detection at 23:04, containment at 23:11, and verification checks completed at 23:29.
- Postmortem includes remediation items, follow-up owners, and a shortlist of indicators of compromise we observed.
- Evidence transfer: we can either sign your evidence transfer agreement (DocuSign link) or push encrypted artifacts to an S3 bucket with expiry; we will provide SHA256 checksums.

Links/attachments: prosperity_pay_postmortem_v1.0.pdf (postmortem, redacted), prosperity_pay_event_logs_redacted.tar.gz (original logs you supplied; we preserved checksums). Drive link for shared artifacts: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C_postmortem. Internal tracking: Redwood SEC ticket SEC-789.

Next steps (proposed):
- Confirm transfer method and execute agreement (legal).
- Joint 60-minute review the week of Jan 22 to walk the timeline and agree on remediation close criteria.
- Redwood to publish an internal runbook update and notify affected customers if additional follow-up required.

If you need additional redaction or a version with fewer technical digests for your board, tell me what fields to remove and we will prepare a public-facing summary.

Thanks — appreciate the collaborative approach.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachments: prosperity_pay_postmortem_v1.0.pdf
